questions.question: Which scheme launched by the Government of India in 2000 aims to provide connectivity to unconnected habitations as part of the poverty reduction strategy?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is the most widely spoken language in India, according to the Census 2011?

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (tropical monsoon type) है।

options: Secretary General of the Lok Sabha
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Comptroller and Auditor General) है।

questions.question: कौन-सा इस्लामी त्यौहार, इब्राहिम द्वारा अपने बेटे की कुर्बानी देने के अल्लाह के आदेश का पालन करने की इच्छा के सम्मान में मनाया जाता है?
In which of the following economies does money NOT play any role?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Economy with only one individual) है।

questions.question: Which international organisation has approved a US $100 million project to boost skill development and employment for women and youth in Sikkim?

Which of the following lakes is famous for salt production?

Which of the following statements about the ‘Charter Act of 1833’ are correct?A)  The Act elevated the Governor General of Bengal to the position of the Governor General of India, giving him complete civil and military authority.B)  It took away the legislative powers of the governors of Bombay and Madras.C)  It brought the East India Company's economic activity to a stop, and it became solely an administrative body.D)  Lord William Bentinck was the Governor General of India when this Act was passed.
options: All A, B, C and D
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (All A, B, C and D) है।

questions.question: Which Fundamental Right is violated if a child below the age of 14 is employed in a hazardous job?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Right against Exploitation) है।

Which of the following is NOT an objective of the World Trade Organization (WTO)?
options: To provide a platform for trade negotiations and dispute settlement
To promote free and fair international trade
To encourage transparency in trade policies and decision-making
To increase trade barriers for better understanding between countries
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (To increase trade barriers for better understanding between countries) है।

questions.question: Which of the following correctly constitute(s) the State Executive as per the Indian Constitution?I. GovernorII. Chief MinisterIII. State Council of MinistersIV. Advocate General of the State

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (All I, II, III and IV) है।
